body:
July 16, 2025

The production release took place after 3:00 p.m. CDT, 7/16/2025.

# Network360 Core Team

This Network360 Core release includes a major update for the Assess Markets feature, new navigation path to the Help Center, new functionality within Create a List, security fixes, and other fixes on the Group Profile page, Compare Networks, and other features.  

# Enhancements

### Assess Markets

This new version of Assess Markets is completely updated – and migrated to Network360 v2!  

With the new UI, users now have more flexibility in their geographic criteria selection.  They can now select a city, county, MSA, or state.  In the past, they could select only a county or MSA. 

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/assess-markets-criteria.png "Assess Markets Criteria Page")

 The Assess Markets report now displays

* the Zelis logo on the cover page,
* the Analysis Criteria on the 3rd page in the report,
* Overlap Summary by provider type, and
* Market Leader results when you check the “Include market leader” checkbox in the report criteria. 

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/assess-markets-export-cover-page.png "Assess Markets export cover page")

### Create a List

Now in Create a List, users can search for providers via the new bulk paste NPIs functionality so they can quickly and efficiently find multiple providers without needing to type each NPI individually.  

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/bulk-npis-create-a-list.png "Create a List New Bulk NPIs on Criteria Page")

### Help Center 

Now, users can access the Help Center via the help icon (question mark with the circle around it) located between the user’s avatar and the activity stream icon in the top right corner of the screen.  

  

![](/cms/cms-assets/media/help-center-icon.png "Help Center Navigation")



### Sidebar Navigation 

Now in all the left sidebar navigation submenus, the options are listed in alphabetical order. 

# Fixes

### Compare Networks

Now, the breadcrumbs continue to display when the user clicks into the Top Network Strength by Zip quadrant to view the details of one zip code.    



### Group Profile

Now, only specialty groups display in the header and the unmapped specialties show in the “Display” dropdown on the Providers tab. 

 

Now, the map tab displays the same number of the group’s provider locations as indicated on the Providers tab. 

### Population File

Now, when a user creates an analysis using a private population file, other non-admin users are unable to view the activity in the activity stream.

### Specifications

Now, when a user creates an analysis using a private specification file, other non-admin users are unable to view the activity in the activity stream. 

### Model Networks

Fixed an issue where finding groups within Model Networks generated an error.  Now, the process of finding groups works correctly without generating an error.
shortDescription: This Network360 Core release includes a major update for the Assess Markets feature, new navigation path to the Help Center, new functionality within Create a List, security fixes, and other fixes on the Group Profile page, Compare Networks, and other features.
